question: Should `/workspace` become a supported runtime-container alias in addition to its sandbox role, or remain sandbox-only with runtime documentation using `/home/node/.openclaw/workspace`?
rationale: Both paths are plausible, but the permanent container-versus-sandbox compatibility contract affects multiple installation surfaces and cannot be selected safely from the issue alone.

options.title: Standardize the runtime alias
options.body: Create and document `/workspace -> /home/node/.openclaw/workspace` across Docker, Compose-generated setup, Podman/Quadlet, and focused smoke coverage.

options.title: Keep `/workspace` sandbox-only
options.body: Retain the current runtime path and update any runtime-facing guidance that implies `/workspace` exists outside sandbox containers.

recommendation.title: Standardize the runtime alias
recommendation.body: Create and document `/workspace -> /home/node/.openclaw/workspace` across Docker, Compose-generated setup, Podman/Quadlet, and focused smoke coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied discussion and feature-history evidence connect this person to both the container baseline and the sandbox path contract.
